description: This source file defines a utility enum 'OverlayPanelFactory' that provides a set of static methods for creating and animating overlay panels/windows in a macOS application using AppKit. It includes functions for constructing panels with specific styles, animating their presentation and dismissal, and applying frame changes with optional animations.

methods.name: makePanel
methods.description: Creates and configures an NSPanel with specified appearance and behavior.

methods.name: animatePresent
methods.description: Animates presenting a window from a start frame to a target frame with fade-in effect.

methods.name: animateFrame
methods.description: Animates moving a window to a specified frame.

methods.name: applyFrame
methods.description: Sets a window's frame with optional animation.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Handles presenting a window, calling specific callbacks depending on whether it's the first presentation or not.

methods.name: animateDismiss
methods.description: Animates dismissing a window by moving it and fading out, then calls a completion handler.

methods.name: animateDismissAndHide
methods.description: Animates dismissing a window and then hides it, calling a callback upon hiding.

methods.name: clearGlobalEventMonitor
methods.description: Removes a global event monitor if it exists.
